facts.text: Cathedral City takes its name from Cathedral Canyon, a rugged gorge just south of the town in the Santa Rosa and San Jacinto Mountains National Monument.
Frank Sinatra’s final resting place lies in Desert Memorial Park cemetery in Cathedral City, beside graves of other famous figures such as Sonny Bono.
The city incorporated in 1981 after a 1925 housing subdivision sparked its development into a desert resort community.
Before European settlers, the land that is Cathedral City was part of the territory of the Cahuilla Indians, whose Agua Caliente Band still governs portions of the city.
Jessup Auto Plaza, founded in 1938, remains a cornerstone of Cathedral City’s automotive heritage, having operated continuously on a 13‑acre campus since 2001.
